title: Subprocess invoked with shell=True in python — review required
description: subprocess is called with shell=True, so the command string is interpreted by a shell. Request text that reaches the string can append commands with shell metacharacters. The rule flags the option; whether the command contains untrusted text is a review decision.
remediation: Pass an argument list with shell left at its default False, and validate dynamic arguments against an allowlist.
limitation: Lexical: matches shell=True on the same line as a subprocess call.
